speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Flight systems online. Citadel traffic control disconnected. Both ion thrusters are at full output.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Flight systems online. Citadel traffic control disconnected. Both ion thrusters are at full output.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Look at the docks behind us. Their fleet is still in its berths. We got out before the net closed.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Look at the docks behind us. Their fleet is still in its berths. We got out before the net closed.

speaker: TITAN
text: Now this is a transport. Built like a fortress. Those mooring clamps never stood a chance.
subtitle: TITAN: Now this is a transport. Built like a fortress. Those mooring clamps never stood a chance.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: The city lights are clear through the storm. No shield overhead. Three districts can see the sky tonight.
subtitle: OCEANUS: The city lights are clear through the storm. No shield overhead. Three districts can see the sky tonight.

speaker: AURA
text: Citadel command is calling every exterior battery to readiness. They know where we are headed.
subtitle: AURA: Citadel command is calling every exterior battery to readiness. They know where we are headed.

speaker: SURYA
text: Target lock ahead. We are through the cloud ceiling. Look at that wall of armor.
subtitle: SURYA: Target lock ahead. We are through the cloud ceiling. Look at that wall of armor.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Outer hull batteries have our signature. Direct flight to the summit is blocked. We need another approach.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Outer hull batteries have our signature. Direct flight to the summit is blocked. We need another approach.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Then we land below them. Maintenance catwalks on the outer hull. We climb the rest on foot.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Then we land below them. Maintenance catwalks on the outer hull. We climb the rest on foot.

speaker: KAITO
text: Agreed. Secure your harnesses. We breach their outer skin and work our way up. Prepare for exterior insertion.
subtitle: KAITO: Agreed. Secure your harnesses. We breach their outer skin and work our way up. Prepare for exterior insertion.
